units.title: Dates et mois
units.focus: days, months, ordinal numbers and dates: 'on the 5th of May', 'in June', 'What's the date today?'
units.goal: Dire et comprendre une date de livraison ou de rendez-vous.

units.title: Au téléphone
units.focus: basic phone phrases: 'Who's calling?', 'Can I speak to…?', 'Hold on, please', 'I'll call you back', 'Can you repeat, please?'
units.goal: Répondre au téléphone et demander à parler à quelqu'un.

units.title: Décrire un produit
units.focus: adjectives before nouns, colours, sizes, materials: 'a big blue bag', 'It's made of cotton', 'small, medium, large'
units.goal: Décrire la couleur, la taille et la matière d'un produit.

units.title: Il y a / il n'y a pas
units.focus: there is / there are / is there…? / there aren't any, in a warehouse: boxes, pallets, trucks
units.goal: Dire ce qu'il y a (ou non) dans un entrepôt ou un camion.

units.title: Raconter une livraison
units.focus: past simple of regular verbs (delivered, arrived, loaded, checked) and time markers (yesterday, last week, ago)
units.goal: Raconter au passé comment s'est passée une livraison.

units.title: Verbes irréguliers du commerce
units.focus: irregular past simple: bought, sold, sent, paid, took, gave, made, got; negative 'didn't' + base verb
units.goal: Utiliser les verbes irréguliers les plus courants du commerce.

units.title: Comparer les prix
units.focus: comparatives and superlatives: cheaper, more expensive, the best, the cheapest, 'as … as'
units.goal: Comparer des produits et des offres de fournisseurs.

units.title: Quantités
units.focus: some / any / much / many / a lot of / a few / a little with countable and uncountable nouns (rice, money, bags, boxes)
units.goal: Parler de quantités de marchandises sans erreur.

units.title: Commander par e-mail
units.focus: polite requests in emails: 'I would like to order…', 'Could you send…?', 'Please find attached', 'Best regards'
units.goal: Écrire un e-mail de commande court et poli.

units.title: Le futur des livraisons
units.focus: future with will (decisions, promises) and going to (plans): 'The truck is going to leave at 6', 'I'll call you tomorrow'
units.goal: Annoncer des plans et faire des promesses de livraison.

units.title: Paiement et factures
units.focus: payment vocabulary: invoice, pay, paid, due date, cash, bank transfer, mobile money, receipt, balance
units.goal: Parler d'une facture, d'une échéance et d'un moyen de paiement.

units.title: Se plaindre poliment
units.focus: simple complaints: 'There's a problem with…', 'It's broken / damaged / missing', 'I'd like a refund / a replacement'
units.goal: Signaler un problème de marchandise poliment.

units.title: Unités et mesures
units.focus: weights and measures: kilo, tonne, metre, litre, 20-foot / 40-foot container, 'How heavy is it?', 'It weighs…'
units.goal: Donner un poids, une taille et un type de conteneur.

units.title: Discuter avec un client
units.focus: small talk: weather, weekend, family, travel; 'How was your trip?', 'Did you have a good weekend?'
units.goal: Faire la conversation avant de parler affaires.

units.title: Documents d'expédition
units.focus: shipping documents: bill of lading (B/L), commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, delivery note; 'We need a copy of…'
units.goal: Nommer et demander les documents d'une expédition.

units.title: Déclarer en douane
units.focus: customs vocabulary: declare, customs duty, tax, HS code, inspection, clearance, cleared, release
units.goal: Expliquer les étapes du dédouanement.

units.title: Où en est l'expédition ?
units.focus: present perfect with already / yet / just: 'The container has just arrived', 'It hasn't cleared customs yet'
units.goal: Faire le point sur l'avancement d'une expédition.

units.title: Suivre un conteneur
units.focus: tracking vocabulary: ETA, ETD, vessel, berth, port of loading, port of discharge, tracking number, on schedule
units.goal: Suivre un conteneur et donner une date d'arrivée.

units.title: La voix passive
units.focus: passive voice in present and past: 'The goods are inspected', 'The container was loaded yesterday', 'by + agent'
units.goal: Décrire un processus logistique avec la voix passive.

units.title: Entrepôt et stock
units.focus: warehouse vocabulary: pallet, forklift, shelf, stock, out of stock, inventory, to store, to unload
units.goal: Parler du stock et des opérations d'entrepôt.

units.title: Route et frontières
units.focus: road transport: truck, driver, border post, waybill, checkpoint, convoy, transit corridor (Lomé–Ouagadougou, Abidjan–Bamako)
units.goal: Organiser un transport routier qui passe une frontière.

units.title: Retards et causes
units.focus: giving reasons: because, because of, due to, as a result, so; delay, postpone, behind schedule
units.goal: Expliquer la cause d'un retard et ses conséquences.

units.title: Réunion d'équipe
units.focus: meeting language: agenda, minutes, action points, 'Let's start with…', 'Any other business?', 'Who is responsible for…?'
units.goal: Participer à une réunion simple en anglais.

units.title: Si… : conditionnels 1 et 2
units.focus: first conditional (If the ship arrives today, we will…) and second conditional (If we had more trucks, we would…)
units.goal: Parler des possibilités réelles et imaginaires.

units.title: Faire une offre
units.focus: quotations: quotation, quote, valid until, unit price, minimum order, lead time, 'We are pleased to offer…'
units.goal: Rédiger et présenter une offre commerciale.

units.title: Négocier un prix
units.focus: negotiation phrases: 'Could you do better on the price?', 'If you order more, we can…', meet halfway, final offer, deal
units.goal: Négocier un prix et trouver un accord.

units.title: Conditions de paiement
units.focus: payment terms: deposit, advance payment, instalments, 30 days net, letter of credit, overdue, late payment fee
units.goal: Discuter des conditions et des délais de paiement.

units.title: Réclamation formelle
units.focus: formal complaint writing: 'I am writing to complain about…', 'I would appreciate it if…', compensation, unacceptable
units.goal: Écrire une réclamation formelle et efficace.

units.title: Répondre à une réclamation
units.focus: handling complaints: 'We sincerely apologise for…', investigate, look into, resolve, goodwill gesture, 'It won't happen again'
units.goal: Répondre à un client mécontent et garder sa confiance.

units.title: Rapporter des propos
units.focus: reported speech: said / told / asked, tense backshift (He said the truck was late), reported questions
units.goal: Rapporter ce qu'un client ou un collègue a dit.

units.title: Phrasal verbs du business
units.focus: business phrasal verbs: set up, follow up, call off, carry out, put off, sort out, look into, take over
units.goal: Comprendre et utiliser les phrasal verbs les plus fréquents.

units.title: Entretien d'embauche
units.focus: job interview: strengths, weaknesses, experience, 'I have been working in logistics for five years', present perfect continuous
units.goal: Se présenter et défendre sa candidature en entretien.

units.title: Présenter des chiffres
units.focus: describing trends: increase, decrease, rise, fall, sharply, slightly, steadily, reach a peak, by 10 %
units.goal: Commenter des chiffres de ventes ou de volumes.

units.title: Convaincre un client
units.focus: persuasion: benefits vs features, 'This will save you…', 'I'm confident that…', handling objections
units.goal: Convaincre un client avec des arguments clairs.

units.title: Incoterms : EXW, FOB, CIF
units.focus: Incoterms 2020 EXW, FOB, CFR, CIF: who pays freight and insurance, where risk passes
units.goal: Expliquer qui paie quoi selon l'Incoterm choisi.

units.title: Incoterms : DAP, DDP et risques
units.focus: Incoterms DAP, DPU, DDP, FCA; transfer of risk, import duties, 'the seller bears the risk until…'
units.goal: Choisir le bon Incoterm et en expliquer les risques.

units.title: Lire un contrat
units.focus: contract language: shall, liable, liability, terminate, clause, breach, force majeure, 'in accordance with'
units.goal: Comprendre les clauses principales d'un contrat commercial.

units.title: Assurance marchandises
units.focus: cargo insurance: policy, premium, cover, claim, loss, damage, surveyor, 'all risks', 'to file a claim'
units.goal: Déclarer un sinistre et parler de couverture d'assurance.

units.title: Crédit documentaire
units.focus: letters of credit: applicant, beneficiary, issuing bank, confirming bank, discrepancy, documents presented, expiry date
units.goal: Expliquer le fonctionnement d'un crédit documentaire.

units.title: Litiges et surestaries
units.focus: disputes: demurrage, detention, free time, dispute, arbitration, waive, 'we are not liable for…'
units.goal: Défendre sa position dans un litige sur des frais portuaires.

units.title: Regrets et conditionnel 3
units.focus: third conditional and mixed conditionals: 'If we had shipped earlier, we would have avoided…', 'I wish we had…', should have
units.goal: Analyser une erreur passée et ce qu'il aurait fallu faire.

units.title: Formel ou informel
units.focus: register: formal emails vs casual messages; 'I would be grateful if…' vs 'Can you…?'; 'regarding' vs 'about'
units.goal: Adapter son niveau de langue à l'interlocuteur.

units.title: Inversion et emphase
units.focus: emphasis: 'Not only… but also', 'Never have we…', cleft sentences 'What we need is…', 'It was the driver who…'
units.goal: Mettre en valeur une idée importante.

units.title: Négociation avancée
units.focus: advanced negotiation: concession, leverage, deal-breaker, bottom line, 'I'm afraid that's non-negotiable', 'Let's explore other options'
units.goal: Mener une négociation complexe avec diplomatie.

units.title: Pitch à des investisseurs
units.focus: pitching: market opportunity, scalable, return on investment, traction, 'We are seeking…', 'Our edge is…'
units.goal: Présenter un projet à des investisseurs de façon percutante.

units.title: Expressions idiomatiques
units.focus: business idioms: ballpark figure, cut corners, get the ball rolling, back to square one, on the same page, a win-win
units.goal: Comprendre et placer les idiomes courants du business.

units.title: Nuancer son propos
units.focus: hedging: arguably, it would appear that, to some extent, tend to, it might be worth considering
units.goal: Exprimer une opinion avec nuance et prudence.

units.title: Humour et sous-entendus
units.focus: British understatement and politeness: 'not ideal', 'a bit of a problem', 'with all due respect', what people really mean
units.goal: Décoder ce que veulent vraiment dire les Britanniques.

units.title: L'anglais d'Afrique de l'Ouest
units.focus: West African English in business (Nigeria, Ghana): 'I'm coming' (= I'll be right back), 'flash me' (= give me a missed call), 'How far?' (= how are you / what's the news), 'Well done' as a greeting at work; compared with standard English
units.goal: Comprendre les tournures de tes partenaires nigérians et ghanéens.

units.title: Rédiger un rapport
units.focus: report writing: executive summary, findings, recommendations, 'It is recommended that…', impersonal style
units.goal: Rédiger un rapport clair et structuré.

units.title: Gérer une crise
units.focus: crisis communication: reassure, take responsibility, transparency, 'We are fully aware of…', 'Our priority is…'
units.goal: Communiquer calmement pendant une crise.

units.title: Diriger une réunion
units.focus: chairing: 'Let's move on', 'To sum up', 'Could we stick to the agenda?', interrupting politely, reaching a decision
units.goal: Animer une réunion et la faire aboutir.

units.title: Négocier entre cultures
units.focus: intercultural negotiation: directness, saving face, building relationships first, reading between the lines, polite refusals
units.goal: Adapter sa négociation à la culture de l'autre.

units.title: Salon et réseautage
units.focus: networking: elevator pitch, business card, 'What line of business are you in?', following up after an event
units.goal: Se présenter et créer des contacts dans un salon.
